plan.design: 243 pairwise-balanced joint combinations + baseline and its one-axis alternatives, deduplicated.
plan.training: First four years only. Rank coarse set by return. Expand each of top three with all 14 single-axis alternatives within declared levels, once only. Rank all trained versions by training return; freeze top 12.
plan.validation: Middle two years. Evaluate top 12, original baseline, and all 14 one-axis neighbors of each top-12 candidate. Only the top 12 may be selected. Pick greatest middle-two-year return, ID tie break. Neighbor results diagnose fragility; they cannot enter the shortlist or change the ranking rule.
plan.final: Lock selected candidate before touching last two years. Evaluate only it, baseline and training-return leader. Never promote a final-period winner or adjust a threshold after final results. Then show eight-year and annual descriptive results for these same locked candidates.
plan.stop_rule: Stop after this bounded search regardless of final results. No further parameter grid or BTC long-only alteration.
plan.assessment: Report final aggregate, both individual final years, comparison with baseline, and validation-neighbor positive fraction/median. No win-rate gate. Passing checks is evidence, not proof against overfitting.
plan.leakage_limit: BTC baseline/other historical strategies on 2024-2026 were already examined in this conversation. This is a chronological final test withheld from THIS new parameter selection, not a wholly untouched historical dataset. BTC is also related to ETH.
plan.execution: Original v4 entry and exit code; next observed open after close signal; fixed entry-relative stop; opposite signal exit; profit protection updated after close for next bar. 100% current equity reinvested; no fees/slippage/leverage.
plan.gaps: Reuse original project MarketDataService/KlineStore snapshot with documented gaps. No interpolated candles. Original observed-bar simulator assumptions retained.
